# Contributing to the PHP manual

Thank you for helping to improve the PHP documentation.

## Quick start

1. Fork `php/doc-en` and create a branch from `master`.
2. Edit the XML files (typos and short changes can be made directly on GitHub).
3. For larger changes, [build the manual locally](https://github.com/php/doc-base/blob/master/docs/local-setup.md)
   to check that the XML is valid and renders as expected.
4. Open a pull request against `php/doc-en`.

The repository runs a few checks on every pull request (DocBook lint, XML
validity, trailing whitespace).

## Guidelines

The full guidelines live in the `doc-base` repository:

- [Contributing to the PHP Documentation](https://github.com/php/doc-base/blob/master/docs/contributing.md)
- [Documentation style](https://github.com/php/doc-base/blob/master/docs/style.md)
- [Coding standard for examples](https://github.com/php/doc-base/blob/master/docs/cs-for-examples.md)
- [Documentation pipeline overview](https://github.com/php/doc-base/blob/master/docs/overview.md)

## Reporting a problem

Use the issue templates to
[report a bug or suggest an improvement](https://github.com/php/doc-en/issues/new/choose).
